student:136.68:aebdb344.label: adjective order
student:136.68:aebdb344.explanation: Adjectives of origin should come after opinion adjectives, so 'traditional Chinese outfits' is correct.
rewrites: But this Jackson Wong Shu Nil kid also posts a lot of content where he's wearing traditional Chinese outfits.

student:151.15:a1fe89ad.label: missing verb
student:151.15:a1fe89ad.explanation: The phrase 'made but' is incomplete; a verb is missing after 'made'.
rewrites: So, of course, this immediately made waves, but hey, even I'm a bit jealous.
So, of course, this immediately made an impact, but hey, even I'm a bit jealous.

student:177.56:d98a507d.label: wrong word choice
student:177.56:d98a507d.explanation: 'Tally' is likely a mis-transcription; the intended word is 'bride price'.
rewrites: A bride price, which is paying money to her in-laws to get their approval.

student:181.19:f8670086.label: wrong preposition
student:181.19:f8670086.explanation: The phrase 'on top of' is misused; should be 'in addition to'.
rewrites: Which by the way is already frequently in addition to providing a house and a car.
Which by the way is already frequently on top of providing a house and a car.

student:214.87:0a598b7d.label: wrong word choice
student:214.87:0a598b7d.explanation: 'Swerved' doesn't fit; you likely mean 'surged' or 'grew'.
rewrites: Then the anger surged within a few days.
Then the anger grew within a few days.

student:224.77:b7bb416b.label: verb form
student:224.77:b7bb416b.explanation: The verb 'favor' should be 'favoring' to match the gerund phrase structure.
rewrites: And why do Chinese women always favor foreigners started popping up.
And why do Chinese women always favor foreigners started popping up.

student:237.47:92f7055e.label: missing adjective
student:237.47:92f7055e.explanation: The phrase 'become more' is incomplete; an adjective is missing.
rewrites: China still needs to develop its economy and become more prosperous in order to build a stronger collective confidence.
China still needs to develop its economy and become stronger in order to build a stronger collective confidence.
